Please do not disclose sensitive vulnerabilities in public issues.

If the issue could expose health data, local database contents, app-lock state,
notification privacy behavior, backup/export data, or other private user
information, send it privately to:

kenoyek@gmail.com

Use this public template only for non-sensitive security hardening suggestions.
